title: Four months at the Suburban Gardens supper club
summary: A ballroom, supper club and gambling place with only the band featured; booked for four weeks, the band stayed four months and Armstrong was popular with the white crowd.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Cabarets, honky-tonks and the Storyville nightlife scene

blocks.x: Well, the Suburban Garden; was that a ballroom or a nightclub or what?
It was a ballroom, a dinner -- what do you call it -- supper club.
Did they have shows, or was it just a band featured?
Excuse me. Just the band featured.
Well, you must have did very good business.
Did it. Tell you what, there was a fellow came out there, says, 'Louis, play Shine'. I just lost $10,000.'
But Louis was quite popular with the white people and --
Oh, yes, very much so. Very much popular.
